perm.alert.title: GoTab needs two permissions to switch windows
perm.alert.needAccessibility: • Accessibility — to enumerate windows and raise the one you pick.
perm.alert.needScreenRecording: • Screen Recording — for window titles and the live thumbnails.
perm.alert.instructions: Turn these on in System Settings › Privacy & Security. GoTab notices the change on its own — there is no need to relaunch it.
perm.cli.grantPrompt: gotab: grant the missing permission in System Settings › Privacy & Security:
perm.cli.screenRecordingOff: gotab: Screen Recording is off — no thumbnails, and no titles for other apps.
perm.cli.waitingAccessibility: gotab: waiting for Accessibility — grant it in System Settings; ^C to stop.
perm.cli.accessibilityStillMissing: gotab: Accessibility still not granted — quitting. Re-open GoTab after granting it.
update.devBuild: gotab %s: development build — skipping the update check.
